
# --- PixelPlus base settings (all boards) ---------------------------------------
# Board-specific settings (DPI pixel engine overlay, pin defaults, RTC, ...) live in
# pixelplus.conf, included at the end of this file. It is generated on first boot
# after the board is detected (`pixelplus config-txt --board <id>`) and regenerated by
# PixelPlus when you change the board or the longest string. Set board= in
# pixelplus.txt to override detection. Keep dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d (above) enabled:
# the pixel engine uses the KMS display stack.
[all]
# i2c-1 on GPIO2/3: board EEPROM (0x50), temperature/power sensors, RTC, OLED
dtparam=i2c_arm=on
# GPIO14/15 are pixel data lines on the 60-port board - keep the serial console off
enable_uart=0
# Faster, quieter boot
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0

# PixelPlus board settings (pixel output overlay, RTC, ...) live in pixelplus.conf,
# generated by `pixelplus config-txt`. Do not remove this line.
[all]
include pixelplus.conf
